title: 133 Krysy 3
prompt: Low-angle close-up of exactly three plague rats crawling out of a broken iron sewer grate onto the stone floor of a castle cellar, each rat different: the first rat on the left is big and black with a torn ear and glowing orange eyes, the second rat in the middle is skinny and grey with patchy fur and a glowing orange crack along its back, the third rat on the right is small and brown with a long scarred tail and orange chaos smoke leaking from its mouth; bright orange chaos plague smoke and crackling orange lightning rise from the sewer behind them, orange sparks. Only three rats. No people. Background: cold dark teal stone cellar vaults with grain sacks, strong contrast of glowing orange chaos against cold dark teal. No text.
